topics.inclusion_rule: Studies whose ledger names the English LRW benchmark or the Mandarin LRW-1000 / CAS-VSR-W1K benchmark (word-level lip reading), classified by the temporal back end their full text names: recurrent (LSTM or GRU), temporal convolution (TCN, MS-TCN, DC-TCN or a temporal-convolution back end), Transformer, Conformer. Boundary: a study counts under every design its text names, related-work mentions included (upper bound); audio-visual studies stay in; versions count once by key; dated split by first public month (prior before 2019-07, [concurrent] 2019-07 to 2020-07, [later] after).

Boundary: pattern counts include related-work mentions (upper bound); versions count once by key; dated as for the M06 topic.
